mapper.select: INSERT INTO tasks (tenant_id, project_id, title, description) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{project,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler}, #{title}, #{description}) RETURNING id::text, project_id::text, title, description, status, version, created_at, updated_at

SELECT id::text, project_id::text, title, description, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM tasks WHERE project_id = #{project,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} AND id = #{id}

UPDATE tasks SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, updated_at = date_trunc('milliseconds', clock_timestamp()) WHERE project_id = #{project,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} RETURNING id::text, project_id::text, title, description, status, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tasks WHERE project_id = #{project,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
